image_prompts: A whistle hanging on a black and white striped shirt, sports field background
A hand holding up a yellow card during a soccer game, blurred stadium
words.image_desc_en: A referee's whistle and yellow card, representing authority in sports.
words.image_desc_cn: 裁判的哨子和黄牌，代表体育运动中的权威。
words.usage: n. (复数 referees); v. (过去式 refereed, 过去分词 refereed)
words.collocations: head referee, assistant referee, game referee

examples.en: The referee made a fair decision during the basketball match.
examples.cn: 在篮球比赛中，裁判做出了公正的判决。

examples.en: He refereed many football games at the local sports center.
examples.cn: 他在当地体育中心裁判了很多足球比赛。

socratic_questions.question: 在足球比赛中，谁负责监督比赛规则并做出判决？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人确保比赛公平进行，并且有权做出决定。

sentences: The ___ blew his whistle to signal the end of the game.

image_prompts: A hand reaching out to reclaim a book from a shelf, soft lighting
A receipt lying on a store counter next to a returned item, blurred background
words.image_desc_en: A hand taking back a book; a returned item with a receipt.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只手拿回一本书；一张收据和一件退回的商品。
words.usage: v. (过去式 took back, 过去分词 taken back) 表示将某物归还或撤回说过的话。
words.collocations: take back a statement, take back goods

examples.en: I have to take this shirt back to the store tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我明天必须把这件衬衫退回商店。

examples.en: He decided to take back what he said about her skills.
examples.cn: 他决定收回他之前对她技能的评价。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你买的东西不合适，你会怎么做？或者，如果你说错了话，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要把东西还给商家，或者撤回之前说过的话。

sentences: I had to ___ the library book ___ because it was overdue.

image_prompts: A forked road with signs pointing in different directions, under a cloudy sky
A judge's gavel resting on a stack of legal documents, courtroom setting
words.image_desc_en: A visual representation of making a choice and a symbol of legal judgment.
words.image_desc_cn: 选择的视觉表现和法律判决的象征。
words.usage: 名词 n.
words.collocations: make a decision, good decision, important decision

examples.en: It was a difficult decision to make, but I did it.
examples.cn: 这是一个很难做的决定，但我还是做了。

examples.en: The final decision rests with the school principal this time.
examples.cn: 最终的决定权在于这次的校长。

socratic_questions.question: 当你面临多个选项，需要从中选择一个时，你正在做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个过程涉及权衡利弊，最终确定一个行动方案。

sentences: Making a quick ___ is sometimes necessary in emergencies.

image_prompts: A scoreboard displaying numbers in a sports stadium, bright lights
A musical sheet with notes and symbols indicating a high-pitched melody
words.image_desc_en: A scoreboard and a musical sheet.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个记分牌和一张乐谱。
words.usage: n. 得分，分数；乐谱 v. (scored, scored) 得分，记分
words.collocations: high score, musical score

examples.en: Our team managed to score three goals in the second half.
examples.cn: 我们队在下半场设法得了三个球。

examples.en: The film's score was composed by a famous musician.
examples.cn: 这部电影的乐谱是由一位著名的音乐家创作的。

socratic_questions.question: 在体育比赛中，用来记录双方表现的数据是什么？演奏音乐时，演奏者依据什么来演奏？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 一个表示比赛结果，一个表示音乐的构成。

sentences: She managed to ___ a high grade on her English exam.

image_prompts: A gold medal displayed on a velvet cushion, spotlight shining
A peacock displaying its vibrant feathers in a lush garden
words.image_desc_en: A feeling of deep satisfaction from one's own achievements or the achievements of those with whom one is associated.
words.image_desc_cn: 因某人或与某人相关的人的成就而感到深深的满足。
words.usage: adj. proudly (adv.)
words.collocations: proud of, feel proud, very proud

examples.en: My parents are very proud of my good grades in school.
examples.cn: 我的父母为我在学校取得的好成绩感到非常自豪。

examples.en: She felt proud when her team won the basketball game.
examples.cn: 当她的队伍赢得篮球比赛时，她感到很自豪。

socratic_questions.question: 当你完成一个非常困难的任务时，你心里会是什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉是因为你做得很好，或者别人做得很好。

sentences: He felt very ___ when he received the award for his invention.

image_prompts: A golden trophy displayed on a shelf, bathed in warm light
A graduation cap and diploma lying on a table, sunlight streaming through a window
words.image_desc_en: A trophy and a graduation cap, symbolizing achievement and pride.
words.image_desc_cn: 奖杯和毕业帽，象征着成就和自豪。
words.usage: adj. feeling pleased and satisfied about something you own or have done, or are connected with
words.collocations: be proud of sb/sth, feel proud of, very proud of
words.preposition_combos: proud of + 名词/代词/动名词

examples.en: She is very proud of her excellent performance in the exam.
examples.cn: 她为自己在考试中的出色表现感到非常自豪。

examples.en: We are all proud of our school's achievements in sports.
examples.cn: 我们都为我们学校在体育方面的成就感到自豪。

socratic_questions.question: 当你完成了一件非常棒的事情，或者你的朋友取得了很大的进步，你心里会是什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉是积极的，表示你对某人或某事感到非常满意和高兴。

sentences: My parents are very ___ me because I got good grades.
She is ___ her ability to speak English fluently.

image_prompts: A large bus with comfortable seats parked at a bus station, luggage compartment open
A whistle hanging around the neck of a clipboard resting on a sports field, cones in background
words.image_desc_en: A bus and a sports coach's equipment
words.image_desc_cn: 一辆巴士和运动教练的装备
words.meaning_cn: n. 教练；长途汽车 v. 训练，指导
words.usage: n. (复数 coaches) ; v. (过去式 coached, 过去分词 coached)
words.collocations: football coach, travel by coach, coach a team
words.preposition_combos: coach in (a sport), coach for (a team)

examples.en: Our school hired a new basketball coach last week.
examples.cn: 我们学校上周聘请了一位新的篮球教练。

examples.en: The coach helped the team improve their skills quickly.
examples.cn: 教练帮助球队迅速提高了他们的技能。

socratic_questions.question: 在体育运动中，谁负责指导和训练运动员？或者，如果我们要长途旅行，通常会乘坐什么交通工具？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词既可以指体育运动中的指导者，也可以指一种大型交通工具。

sentences: The travel ___ arrived late due to the heavy rain.

image_prompts: Two identical gift boxes wrapped in colorful paper, side by side
A plate with a slice of cake, and another plate with a similar slice of cake next to it
words.image_desc_en: Two items are present, indicating 'also' or 'in addition'.
words.image_desc_cn: 两件物品同时存在，表示“也”、“此外”。
words.usage: adv.
words.collocations: as well as

examples.en: He speaks English fluently, and he speaks French as well.
examples.cn: 他英语说得很流利，法语也说得很好。

examples.en: She enjoys reading novels, and she likes watching movies as well.
examples.cn: 她喜欢读小说，也喜欢看电影。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人喜欢游泳，而且他也喜欢跑步，你会怎么表达他同样喜欢跑步？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示除了游泳之外，跑步也是他喜欢的项目。

sentences: She ordered pizza, and she got a drink ___ ___.

image_prompts: A small metal drill bit used for woodworking, shavings around the hole
A tiny chocolate bit on top of a vanilla ice cream scoop, close-up
words.image_desc_en: A small piece or a tool.
words.image_desc_cn: 小块，少量；钻头。
words.usage: n. 一点，少量；小块；钻头
words.collocations: a bit of, every bit

examples.en: I ate a bit of cake after dinner last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚晚饭后吃了一小块蛋糕。

examples.en: He needs a bit more time to finish his homework.
examples.cn: 他需要多一点时间来完成他的作业。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想吃蛋糕，但又不想吃太多，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示“少量”的含义。

sentences: She felt a ___ nervous before her final exam.

image_prompts: A small pile of sand on a beach, with a few grains scattered around
A thermometer showing a slight increase in temperature from a baseline
words.image_desc_en: A small amount or degree of something.
words.image_desc_cn: 少量，一点儿。
words.usage: adv. 稍微地；n. 一点，少量
words.collocations: a bit of, a bit more, feel a bit

examples.en: I'm feeling a bit tired after the long school day.
examples.cn: 经过漫长的一天学习后，我感觉有点累。

examples.en: Could you turn the music down a bit, please?
examples.cn: 请你把音乐声音调小一点，好吗？

socratic_questions.question: 如果你觉得有点冷，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表达程度轻微，不是完全冷，而是“有点”。

sentences: The soup needs ___ more salt to improve its taste.

image_prompts: An audio player with a 'repeat' button highlighted, playing the same song again
A handwritten note saying 'Please repeat' next to a microphone on a desk
words.image_desc_en: An audio player repeating a song and a note asking to repeat something.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个音频播放器重复播放一首歌，以及一张纸条要求重复某事。
words.usage: v. (repeated, repeated) to say or do something again; n. an act of repeating something
words.collocations: repeat a word, repeat an action, repeat after

examples.en: Could you please repeat the question? I didn't hear it clearly.
examples.cn: 你能重复一下这个问题吗？我没听清楚。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to repeat the new words loudly.
examples.cn: 老师要求学生们大声重复这些新单词。

socratic_questions.question: 如果别人说的话你没听清，你会怎么礼貌地请他再说一遍？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 你需要请求对方再次说一遍相同的内容。

sentences: The instructions were unclear, so I had to ___ them.
The teacher asked the student to ___ the sentence after her.

image_prompts: A group of ropes tied together, each rope a different color, symbolizing unity
Gears interlocking and turning smoothly, representing teamwork and collaboration
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of unity and teamwork.
words.image_desc_cn: 象征团结和团队合作的视觉表现。
words.usage: v. to work together in a determined way to achieve something
words.collocations: pull together as a team, pull together to overcome
words.preposition_combos: pull together for, pull together with

examples.en: We need to pull together if we want to win the game.
examples.cn: 如果我们想赢得比赛，我们需要齐心协力。

examples.en: The community had to pull together after the earthquake.
examples.cn: 地震后，社区不得不团结合作。

socratic_questions.question: 当团队遇到困难，需要共同努力克服时，你会用什么词来形容这种行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词强调的是团队成员共同努力，朝着同一个目标前进。

sentences: The whole class had to ___ to finish the project on time.

image_prompts: A lightbulb illuminating above a maze, representing a breakthrough
A chemical beaker with a clear liquid, all substances fully dissolved
words.image_desc_en: A lightbulb above a maze; a beaker with dissolved substances.
words.image_desc_cn: 迷宫上方的一个灯泡；一个装有溶解物质的烧杯。
words.usage: n. (pl. solutions)
words.collocations: find a solution, offer a solution, simple solution

examples.en: We need to find a quick solution to this difficult problem.
examples.cn: 我们需要找到一个解决这个难题的快速方案。

examples.en: The best solution is to recycle more and waste less.
examples.cn: 最好的解决办法是多回收利用，减少浪费。

socratic_questions.question: 当遇到数学难题时，我们通常会寻找什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是解决问题或困境的方法。

sentences: The teacher provided a clear ___ to the complex math problem.

image_prompts: A winding road through a dense forest, sunlight filtering through the trees
A closed book with a bookmark sticking out, placed on a wooden table
words.image_desc_en: A road through a forest and a closed book.
words.image_desc_cn: 穿过森林的道路和一本合上的书。
words.usage: 连词 conj. / 副词 adv.
words.collocations: even though, as though

examples.en: Though it rained, we still had a great time at the park.
examples.cn: 虽然下雨了，我们在公园里仍然玩得很开心。

examples.en: She felt nervous, though she tried to hide it from others.
examples.cn: 她感到紧张，虽然她试图对别人隐瞒。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一件事情发生了，但是结果却出乎意料，你会用哪个词来连接这两件事？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示转折或让步，引导一个与主要观点相反的信息。

sentences: ___ it was late, they continued to study for the exam.

image_prompts: A winding road leading up a steep mountain, overcast sky
A single flower blooming in a crack in a concrete wall, resilience
words.image_desc_en: A challenging path or a resilient flower, showing contrast with difficulty.
words.image_desc_cn: 一条通往陡峭山顶的蜿蜒道路，或是一朵在水泥墙缝隙中盛开的花朵，展示了与困难的对比。
words.usage: 连词 conj.
words.collocations: even though + clause

examples.en: Even though it rained, we still enjoyed our school trip.
examples.cn: 即使下雨了，我们仍然很享受我们的学校旅行。

examples.en: Even though I studied hard, I didn't pass the exam.
examples.cn: 即使我努力学习了，我也没有通过考试。

socratic_questions.question: 在某种情况下，某件事发生了，但结果却出乎意料或与预期相反。你会用哪个词来表达这种转折关系？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词组表示一种让步关系，即承认一个事实，但强调另一个不同的结果。

sentences: ___ it was late, they continued to work on the project.

image_prompts: A handwritten note saying 'I'm sorry' with a wilted flower next to it
A cracked vase with water spilled around it, indicating regret
words.image_desc_en: A note expressing regret and a damaged vase symbolizing the need for an apology.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张表达歉意的便条和一只象征需要道歉的破损花瓶。
words.usage: v. (过去式 apologized, 过去分词 apologized)
words.collocations: apologize to (someone) for (something)

examples.en: I must apologize to my teacher for being late to class.
examples.cn: 我必须为上课迟到向我的老师道歉。

examples.en: She apologized for the mistake she made on the test.
examples.cn: 她为考试中犯的错误道歉了。

socratic_questions.question: 当你做错事，想要表达你的后悔和请求原谅时，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个行为通常包含说'对不起'，以减轻对方的不满。

sentences: You should ___ to your friend for breaking his favorite toy.

image_prompts: A complex machine with gears jammed and smoke coming out, indicating malfunction
A GPS navigation screen showing a rerouting message with a red exclamation mark
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting malfunction and navigation error.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘故障和导航错误的图像。
words.usage: v. (过去式 went wrong, 过去分词 gone wrong)
words.collocations: something go wrong, what went wrong, nothing can go wrong

examples.en: If anything goes wrong, please let me know immediately.
examples.cn: 如果出了什么问题，请立即告诉我。

examples.en: I hope nothing will go wrong during our school trip tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我希望明天的学校旅行一切顺利。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你计划好的事情最终没有按计划进行，你会怎么描述这种情况？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 强调事情没有按照预期的方式发展，出现了偏差。

sentences: Sometimes, even with careful planning, things can ___ unexpectedly.

image_prompts: A field of sunflowers in full bloom under a bright sun, vibrant colors
A group of colorful balloons floating in the air, tied together with ribbons
words.image_desc_en: Sunflowers blooming and colorful balloons symbolize happiness.
words.image_desc_cn: 盛开的向日葵和彩色气球象征着快乐。
words.usage: adj. joyfully (adv.), joyfulness (n.)
words.collocations: joyful occasion, joyful smile, joyful heart

examples.en: The children were joyful when they received their gifts.
examples.cn: 孩子们收到礼物时非常快乐。

examples.en: It was a joyful day for the whole family.
examples.cn: 对整个家庭来说，这是个快乐的日子。

socratic_questions.question: 想象一下你赢得了一场比赛，你感觉如何？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述一种非常开心的情绪。

sentences: She felt ___ when she heard the good news from school.

image_prompts: A heart-shaped balloon floating upwards with a banner that reads 'Gratitude'
A cornucopia overflowing with colorful fruits and vegetables, autumn leaves scattered around
words.image_desc_en: Images representing gratitude and abundance.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表感恩和富足的图像。
words.usage: adj. feeling or expressing gratitude; appreciative
words.collocations: be thankful for, thankful to someone

examples.en: I am thankful for my family's support during the exam period.
examples.cn: 我感谢我的家人在考试期间给予的支持。

examples.en: She was thankful to her friends who helped her move houses.
examples.cn: 她感谢帮助她搬家的朋友们。

socratic_questions.question: 当你收到一份期待已久的礼物时，你心里会是什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉表达了你对给予者的感激之情。

sentences: We are all ___ for the teachers' hard work and dedication.

image_prompts: A black and white film negative showing a landscape scene, bright areas dark and vice versa
A thermometer displaying a temperature below zero degrees Celsius, frost forming on the glass
words.image_desc_en: A film negative and a sub-zero thermometer.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张底片和一个零度以下的温度计。
words.usage: adj. adv. negatively n. negativity
words.collocations: negative attitude, negative effect, test negative

examples.en: He has a negative attitude towards the new school rules.
examples.cn: 他对新的学校规章制度持消极态度。

examples.en: The test results were negative, which was a great relief.
examples.cn: 测试结果是阴性的，这让人松了一口气。

socratic_questions.question: 如果某人总是抱怨并且不相信事情会好转，你会如何形容他的心态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是一种不乐观、不积极的心情。

sentences: Her constant ___ comments made it hard to stay positive.

image_prompts: A cartoon depiction of a large shadow looming over a smaller figure, representing intimidation
A digital illustration of a cracked smartphone screen after being thrown on the ground
words.image_desc_en: Intimidation and damage representing the act of bullying.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表欺凌行为的恐吓和破坏。
words.usage: v. (过去式 bullied, 过去分词 bullied)；n.
words.collocations: bully someone into doing something; school bully

examples.en: Don't bully others; treat everyone with respect and kindness.
examples.cn: 不要欺负别人；要尊重和友善地对待每一个人。

examples.en: The school has a zero-tolerance policy for any form of bully.
examples.cn: 学校对任何形式的欺凌行为都采取零容忍政策。

socratic_questions.question: 如果有人总是用更强壮的身体或更大的权力去伤害或威胁弱小的人，这种行为叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容的是一种不公平的压迫行为，通常发生在力量不对等的情况下。

sentences: It's wrong to ___ someone just because they are different.

image_prompts: A megaphone with sound waves emanating from it, directed towards a distant target.
A person's silhouette with an angry expression, a speech bubble with large, bold text above.
words.image_desc_en: A megaphone projecting sound and an angry silhouette with a speech bubble.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个扩音器发出声音，以及一个愤怒轮廓带着文字泡。
words.usage: v. (过去式 shouted, 过去分词 shouted)
words.collocations: shout angrily at, shout loudly at
words.preposition_combos: shout at sb, shout at the top of one's voice

examples.en: Don't shout at me; I can hear you perfectly well.
examples.cn: 别对我大喊大叫；我能听得很清楚。

examples.en: The teacher had to shout at the noisy students to quiet them.
examples.cn: 老师不得不对吵闹的学生大喊，让他们安静下来。

socratic_questions.question: 当某人做了让你非常生气的事情，你会提高音量并表达不满，这个行为是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个行为不仅仅是说话，而是带着愤怒的情绪大声说话。

sentences: It's not polite to ___ people, even if they make mistakes.

image_prompts: A well-trained dog sitting patiently with a treat on its nose, waiting for permission
A classroom setting with students raising their hands politely to answer questions
words.image_desc_en: A dog behaving well; students behaving politely in class.
words.image_desc_cn: 表现良好的狗；在课堂上表现礼貌的学生。
words.usage: v. (behaved, behaved)
words.collocations: behave well/badly; behave oneself

examples.en: You should behave well in public places, showing respect to others.
examples.cn: 在公共场所你应该表现良好，对他人表示尊重。

examples.en: If you behave yourself, you will be rewarded with extra playtime.
examples.cn: 如果你守规矩，你将会得到额外的玩耍时间作为奖励。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在图书馆里大声喧哗，你的父母可能会说什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 他们会希望你更加注意你的言行举止。

sentences: Children should learn to ___ politely when they meet new people.

image_prompts: A kaleidoscope with various patterns and colors, each section unique
Two winding roads diverging in a forest, one paved and one dirt
words.image_desc_en: Kaleidoscope patterns and diverging roads.
words.image_desc_cn: 万花筒图案和分岔的道路。
words.usage: adv. (形容词 different 的副词形式)
words.collocations: think differently, act differently, look differently

examples.en: We all see the world differently, based on our experiences.
examples.cn: 我们都根据自己的经历，以不同的方式看待世界。

examples.en: The twins behaved differently after they went to different schools.
examples.cn: 这对双胞胎上了不同的学校后，行为举止变得不一样了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果两幅画，一幅是抽象风格，一幅是写实风格，它们的呈现方式是怎样的？

examples.cn: 她不时地打电话给我，询问我的进展。

words.usage: 连词 conjunction
words.collocations: so that + clause

examples.en: I study hard so that I can get good grades.
examples.cn: 我努力学习，以便能取得好成绩。

examples.en: She saved money so that she could travel to Europe.
examples.cn: 她攒钱，为了能去欧洲旅行。

socratic_questions.question: 你做某事的目标是什么？用一个词组来表达。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词组表示目的，说明做某事的原因。

sentences: He practiced every day ___ he could win the competition.

image_prompts: A pressure cooker with steam violently escaping from the valve, gauge needle in the red zone
A shattered mirror with fragments scattered on the floor, a fist-shaped dent in the wall nearby
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting extreme anger or frustration.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘极度愤怒或沮丧的插图。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 madder, 最高级 maddest)
words.collocations: get mad, be mad at, drive someone mad

examples.en: She gets mad when people are late for important meetings.
examples.cn: 当人们在重要会议上迟到时，她会生气。

examples.en: He was mad about missing the school basketball game yesterday.
examples.cn: 他因为错过了昨天的学校篮球比赛而生气。

socratic_questions.question: 当你发现你的作业被别人弄脏了，你可能会有什么情绪？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是一种强烈的不满和愤怒的情绪。

sentences: My dad was ___ when I broke his favorite coffee mug.

image_prompts: A calculator displaying an average value after a series of calculations.
A graph showing a central tendency with data points clustered around the middle.
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing the concept of average and central tendency.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表平均值和中心趋势的概念图示。
words.meaning_cn: 平均的；吝啬的；意味着 v. (meant, meant)
words.usage: adj. / v.
words.collocations: mean temperature, mean to do, what do you mean?

examples.en: The mean temperature in July is usually around 30 degrees Celsius.
examples.cn: 七月份的平均气温通常在摄氏30度左右。

examples.en: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings with my careless words.
examples.cn: 我不是故意用我粗心的话语伤害你的感情。

socratic_questions.question: 如果计算一组数字的总和，然后除以数字的个数，得到的是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示一组数值的中间值。

sentences: What does this sentence ___ in the context of the story?

image_prompts: A deep blue ocean trench with sunlight barely reaching the bottom
A stack of books with 'Deep Thoughts' written on the spine of the top book
words.image_desc_en: A visual representation of depth, both literal and figurative.
words.image_desc_cn: 深度，包括字面意义和引申意义的可视化表达。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 深的；深刻的；adv. 深深地
words.usage: adj. 深的；深刻的；adv. 深深地 (deeper, deepest; deeply)
words.collocations: deep sleep, deep understanding, deep water

examples.en: The lake is very deep, so be careful when swimming.
examples.cn: 这个湖非常深，游泳时要小心。

examples.en: She has a deep understanding of the history of China.
examples.cn: 她对中国历史有着深刻的理解。

socratic_questions.question: 当你潜水时，水面以下很远的地方，你会用什么词来形容？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述距离水面很远的状态。

sentences: The river is quite ___ at this point, so we can't cross it.

image_prompts: A person's chest expanding as they inhale, visible ribs and diaphragm
A close-up of nostrils inhaling air, slight blurring effect to show movement
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing the physical action of taking a deep breath.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示深呼吸这一动作的插图。
words.usage: v. 短语
words.collocations: take a deep breath in, take a deep breath and relax

examples.en: Before the exam, I always take a deep breath to calm down.
examples.cn: 考试之前，我总是深呼吸来让自己冷静下来。

examples.en: When you feel stressed, take a deep breath; it really helps.
examples.cn: 当你感到有压力时，深呼吸；它真的有帮助。

socratic_questions.question: 当你感到紧张或焦虑时，你会做什么来放松自己？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作可以帮助你平静下来，并提供氧气。

sentences: Before speaking in public, it's good to ___ to relax.

image_prompts: A faded photograph on a wooden table, soft light
A single white dove flying into a sunset sky, blurred background
words.image_desc_en: A faded photograph and a dove flying into the sunset, symbolizing passing away.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张褪色的照片和一只飞向日落的鸽子，象征着逝去。
words.usage: v. (passed away, passed away)  委婉语，指人去世
words.collocations: suddenly pass away, peacefully pass away

examples.en: His grandfather passed away peacefully in his sleep last year.
examples.cn: 他的祖父去年在睡梦中安详地去世了。

examples.en: She passed away after a long illness, surrounded by her family.
examples.cn: 她在与疾病抗争多年后去世，家人陪伴在她身边。

socratic_questions.question: 如果用比较委婉的方式描述某人离开了人世，你会用哪个短语？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语比 'die' 更正式和礼貌。

sentences: Her beloved cat ___ peacefully in her arms yesterday.

image_prompts: A silhouette of a crowd with one figure highlighted in bright light.
An empty stage with a single spotlight shining on the center.
words.image_desc_en: A representation of someone among many, or the possibility of someone being present.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示人群中的某人，或某人可能存在的可能性。
words.usage: pron.
words.collocations: ask anybody, tell anybody, hardly anybody
words.preposition_combos: about anybody, for anybody, to anybody

examples.en: Does anybody know the answer to this difficult question?
examples.cn: 有人知道这个难题的答案吗？

examples.en: I didn't see anybody I knew at the school party.
examples.cn: 我在学校聚会上没有看到任何我认识的人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想知道是否有人能帮你解决问题，你会怎么问？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 你需要一个词来表示“任何一个人”

sentences: Did ___ see the meteor shower last night from the campus?
Is there ___ who can help me with this math problem?

image_prompts: A half-eaten apple pie on a wooden table, crumbs scattered around
A single ancient stone pillar standing tall amidst ruins, overgrown with vines
words.image_desc_en: Representing the concept of something left over or staying in place.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示剩余或保持原位的概念。
words.usage: v. (remained, remained)
words.collocations: remain silent, remain calm, remain unchanged

examples.en: You should remain calm during the important final exams.
examples.cn: 在重要的期末考试中，你应该保持冷静。

examples.en: Only a few students will remain in the classroom after school.
examples.cn: 放学后只有少数学生会留在教室里。

socratic_questions.question: 如果考试时遇到难题，为了不影响整体发挥，你应该怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是保持某种状态，或者继续存在。

sentences: Despite the challenges, our friendship will always ___ strong.

image_prompts: A book with two bookmarks, one labeled 'Benefits' and the other 'Enjoyment'
A balanced scale with 'Intelligence' on one side and 'Kindness' on the other
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing the dual aspects or benefits of something.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示某事物双重方面或益处的插图。
words.usage: 连词短语; 连接两个并列的成分，强调两者都存在或都适用。
words.collocations: not only...but also...

examples.en: He is not only smart but also very kind to others.
examples.cn: 他不仅聪明，而且对他人非常友善。

examples.en: She not only sings well but also plays the piano beautifully.
examples.cn: 她不仅歌唱得好，而且钢琴也弹得很棒。

socratic_questions.question: 如果想表达一个人既有优点A，又有优点B，你会用什么短语来连接这两个优点？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语强调两个优点都存在，缺一不可。

sentences: She is ___ a talented artist ___ a skilled writer.
